description: Defines the rx_buffer_impl class implementing a receiver buffer interface with state management, codeblock reservation, CRC handling, and resource management for a radio communication system.

classes.name: rx_buffer_impl
classes.description: Implements a receiver buffer with state management, codeblock reservation, CRC handling, and resource control.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves codeblocks from the pool, resets CRCs if specified, and updates buffer state.

methods.name: get_nof_codeblocks
methods.description: Returns the number of codeblocks in the buffer.

methods.name: reset_codeblocks_crc
methods.description: Resets CRC flags for all codeblocks.

methods.name: get_codeblocks_crc
methods.description: Returns a span of CRC flags for codeblocks.

methods.name: get_absolute_codeblock_id
methods.description: Returns the absolute ID of a codeblock given its index.

methods.name: get_codeblock_soft_bits
methods.description: Retrieves soft bits for a specific codeblock.

methods.name: get_codeblock_data_bits
methods.description: Retrieves data bits for a specific codeblock.

methods.name: try_lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the buffer for exclusive access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the buffer after exclusive access.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the buffer and frees resources.

methods.name: is_free
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is available.

methods.name: is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is locked.

methods.name: expire
methods.description: Expires the buffer, freeing codeblocks if not locked.
